source.title: Timeline of Vintage
source.author: Steve Menendian
source.note: Transcribed from the era chart. Facts only -- dates, card names, era names and citations. The article's prose is the author's and is not reproduced here.
source.credit: Derived from Steve Menendian's Timeline of Vintage at Eternal Central. The dates, era names and citations are his research.

change_kinds.banned_restricted: a card was restricted, unrestricted, banned or unbanned
change_kinds.errata: a card's wording was changed, which can alter the format without any B&R action
change_kinds.rules: a rules or policy change, such as a mulligan rule
change_kinds.format: the format itself changed -- renamed, or a set made legal
change_kinds._note: change_kinds describes what the era's own 'changes' text records. boundary_kinds describes the events that BOUND the era, which is not the same thing: an era bounded by an errata did not necessarily contain one.

eras.name: Wild Era
eras.changes: No Mandatory Banned and Restricted List, Only Alpha/Beta/Unlimited and first expansion set, Arabian Nights.

eras.name: Degenerate Era
eras.changes: First Mandatory Banned and Restricted List Announced January 26, 1994 and format dubbed "Constructed decks."

eras.name: Constructed Magic Begins
eras.changes: Orcish Oriflame & Rukh Egg unrestricted in February and issued errata.

eras.name: Antiquities Arrives
eras.changes: Channel, Copy Artifact, Demonic Tutor, Regrowth, and Wheel of Fortune restricted. Time Vault banned. Icy Manipulator unrestricted.

eras.name: Library of Alexandria Era
eras.changes: Library of Alexandria, Feldon's Cane, Ivory Tower, and Candleabra of Tawnos restricted. Bronze Tablet banned. Dingus Egg and Gauntlet of Might unrestricted.

eras.name: Mind Twist Metagame
eras.changes: Mishra's Workshop restricted June 13, Legends legal June 10.

eras.boundaries: Legends; B&R Update - The Dark; B&R Update
eras.name: Creatureless Era Begins
eras.changes: All-land/no-land Mulligan rule adopted. Chaos Orb, Falling Star, Mind Twist, Mirror Universe, Recall, Sword of the Ages, and Underworld Dream restricted. Divine Intervention and Tempest Efreet banned. First US National Championship held at Origins July 7-10.
